description: rebaseWhen=behind-base-branch: on the gitea/forgejo platform `auto` rebases only conflicting branches, so a branch that fell behind main never got rebased, automerge returned 405 and stale PRs filled prConcurrentLimit (seen 2026-07-26).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly refresh of nodes/ops/flake.lock (nix) and terraform_talos/.terraform.lock.hcl. Schedule `* * * * 1` because the Renovate CronJob runs at 06:00 UTC, outside the default `before 4am on monday`. No automerge: a merged flake.lock is live only after /deploying-ops-node.

packageRules.description: Every update (major, minor, patch, pin) automerges once the required CI checks are green (gitleaks, yamllint, helm-lint, kubeconform, argocd-diff); CI plus ArgoCD health is the gate. No minimumReleaseAge: with the default timestamp-required behaviour GHCR images without an OCI `created` timestamp stayed pending forever (removed 2026-06-14).
Label major bumps for filtering in the Forgejo UI and the Dependency Dashboard. Does not block the merge.

Label major bumps of CRD-carrying components as critical-infra for visibility. Manual approval was dropped on 2026-06-12 (owner decision: everything automerges). Rollback: add automerge:false + dependencyDashboardApproval:true here.
Digest-only docker updates are off: every upstream rebuild would open a PR without a version change.
config:best-practices enables docker:pinDigests, which would open @sha256 pin PRs for every image tag. Tags only; images that need a digest pin it by hand in the manifest.
The Forgejo Actions runner speaks the GHES artifact protocol up to v3. upload/download-artifact 3.2.x+ use the v4 protocol and fail with GHESNotSupportedError.

lampac publishes every release twice, `X.Y.Z` and `vX.Y.Z`. Renovate picks the v-prefixed maximum, treats the prefix flip as a non-bump and skips it silently (stuck on 1.4.3 while 1.34.0 existed). Lock to the non-v lineage.
Group `apps`: updates under argocd/apps/** go in one batch PR; a bad bump takes down one app, not the cluster.

Group `infra`: infra components, AppSet templates, standalone Applications and shared values go in one batch PR. CRD-carrying charts are excluded and get a PR each: a CRD change keeps argocd-diff red until the PR is labelled diff-reviewed, and inside the batch it held every harmless bump with it (PR #815, 2026-10-07).

Group `wazuh`: wazuh-operator (CRDs) and wazuh-cluster (its CR chart) move in one PR, since a cluster chart ahead of its operator renders fields the CRDs do not know. Must come after the `apps` rule (a later matching rule wins). The PR needs diff-reviewed whenever the operator CRDs change.

Group `talos`: Talos OS / Kubernetes bootstrap versions in nodes.yaml. Separate PR: a node upgrade needs a manual `terraform apply`, tuppr rolls the live cluster. The tuppr kubelet version stays in the `infra` batch; keep it in sync with nodes.yaml by hand.

Group `talos` also takes every other copy of the Talos version (tuppr TalosUpgrade and talosctl images, .mise.toml talosctl), so one PR moves them together. Must come after the `infra` rule (a later matching rule wins). The terraform provider siderolabs/talos has its own version line and stays out.
Lint tools and pre-commit itself are pinned in .mise.toml (CI reads it), .pre-commit-config.yaml (hook revs). One PR bumps all copies so CI and the hooks run the same version.

Flake input updates of the ops node do not automerge: nixpkgs versioning turns nixos-26.05 -> nixos-26.11 into a minor update that rule 1 would merge, and a merged flake change is live only after /deploying-ops-node.

forgejo/runner majors do not automerge: v13 has breaking changes, and argocd-diff runs only on this runner, so a broken runner blocks every PR. Merge by hand while no CI is running. Its own group keeps it out of the major-apps batch, which would otherwise lose automerge too.

external-dns does not automerge: it owns real DNS records with policy: sync, and a breaking change shows only after the fact. On 2026-09-12 the 1.21.1 -> 1.22.0 automerge took external DNS down for four hours (annotation prefix changed without fallback). Read the release notes. The rule stays last because a later matching rule wins; its own group keeps it out of the infra batch.

customManagers.description: Helm charts in standalone Applications and ApplicationSet templates (repoURL -> chart -> targetRevision): argo-cd, homelab-common (both AppSets + standalone argocd).
Git-source charts/CRDs in standalone Applications (github .git repoURL + path + targetRevision, no chart:): gateway-api. datasource github-releases, depName from the GitHub path.

Charts in argocd/{apps,infra}/*/config.yaml, parsed structurally with JSONata. `chart:` is required in every config.yaml even when it equals the folder name: without it this manager skips the file (2026-09-24 a cleanup removed it from 37 files and Renovate went blind for a week; scripts/audit-docs.py now fails CI on it). repoURL with a scheme = helm index, scheme-less = OCI = docker datasource. homelab-common is pinned in the AppSet templates, see the first manager.
matchStrings: $exists(chart) and $exists(repoURL) and $exists(targetRevision) ? { "depName": chart, "currentValue": targetRevision, "datasource": $contains(repoURL, "://") ? "helm" : "docker", "packageName": $contains(repoURL, "://") ? chart : repoURL & "/" & chart, "registryUrl": $contains(repoURL, "://") ? repoURL : undefined }

customManagers.description: immich-machine-learning tag = <immich release>-openvino. The docker datasource returns no-result for ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning (~187k tags, GHCR pages 1000 oldest-first), even with an authenticated hostRule. ML ships with the same release as immich-server, so the version comes from github-releases immich-app/immich and `-openvino` stays outside currentValue.

Versions marked with `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>`. No datasourceTemplate on purpose: a template overrides the captured group, and github-releases deps (siderolabs/talos) would hit Docker Hub. Covers argocd/**, terraform_talos/configs/** (nodes.yaml) and .forgejo/workflows/** (argocd-diff job tools).
